reference.code: const nums=s=>{if(!s)return null;let o=[];for(const z of s.split(',')){if(!/^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(z))return null;let x=Number(z);if(x< -1000||x>1000)return null;o.push(x)}return o};exports.magnitudeLeaders=function(s){let a=nums(s);if(!a)return null;let m=Math.max(...a.map(Math.abs));return a.filter(x=>Math.abs(x)===m).join(',')}
